description: JavaScript module defining the SMSManager class for handling SMS notifications within the ERPNext system, including message setup, contact retrieval, and dialog UI interactions.

classes.name: SMSManager
classes.description: Class managing SMS notifications, including message setup, contact retrieval, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes default messages and triggers display based on document type.

methods.name: get_contact_number
methods.description: Fetches contact number via an API call based on contact details.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays SMS dialog, fetching contact number if necessary.

methods.name: show_dialog
methods.description: Creates and displays the SMS input dialog.

methods.name: make_dialog
methods.description: Constructs the SMS input dialog UI with fields and send button.
